Weeknight lentil soup

A quick, one-pot lentil soup that comes together in under forty minutes, built around pantry staples most people already have on hand.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup red lentils
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 2 carrots, diced
  • 4 cups vegetable broth
  • 1 tsp cumin

Instructions

Saute the onion and carrots until softened, add the cumin and toast briefly, then stir in the lentils and broth and simmer for twenty five minutes.
